summary: Re-tested Optidriver Optimizer page after fix. Verified that COMPARATIVA DE IMPACTO panel now renders correctly inside result-panel with all 4 ComparisonCell components (cpu, memory, disk, procs) each showing BEFORE/AFTER/DELTA values and proper color coding (green for improved, gray for no change, red for worse).
critical_code_review_comments: Optimizer.jsx ComparisonCell has no defensive check for missing data fields (data.before, data.after, data.delta). If backend ever returns null/undefined for any metric, it would render 'undefinedundefined' or crash on data.improved access. Consider adding null-safe rendering.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 3 verified the fix for the missing comparativa panel JSX block. Test flow used: navigate to /optimize -> wait for analysis-summary -> click btn-apply-optimization -> wait for result-panel -> verify comparison-panel and 4 cells (comp-cell-cpu, comp-cell-memory, comp-cell-disk, comp-cell-procs). All cells render BEFORE, AFTER, DELTA values. Colors verified via inline styles: improved=green (rgb(16,185,129)), unchanged=gray (rgb(161,161,170)), worse=red (rgb(255,59,48)). CPU showed -14.8% (-42.9%) green, Memory -0.1% (-0.18%) green, Disk 0% gray, Procs 0 gray. App in simulation mode.
rca of the issue: Iteration 2 RCA: backend returned result.comparison object correctly but Optimizer.jsx was missing the JSX render block. Iteration 3 confirms main agent added the block at lines 208-220 with data-testid='comparison-panel' and 4 ComparisonCell children with correct testids.
